in_hebrew.name: Merwin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Merwin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Merwin is derived from Old English words ‘mer’ meaning ‘sea’ or ‘mere’ meaning ‘lake’ and ‘weoran’ meaning ‘to be’ or ‘to become’. The name Merwin is a combination of ‘mer’ and ‘weoran’, meaning ‘friend of the sea’ or ‘friend of the lake’. In Old English, this name was often given to sailors and fishermen as a symbol of protection and strength.
